title: 898. Snakes and Ladders

examples.explanation: Climb the ladder from square 2 to 15, then advance and ride the remaining jumps to reach square 36 in 4 throws.
Roll from square 1 to square 2, whose ladder leads directly to square 4.
With no snakes or ladders, two throws of 6 reach square 9 (1 -> 7 -> 9).

hints: Number the squares from 1 at the bottom-left, snaking back and forth each row, so every cell maps to exactly one square.
From each square the reachable squares are the next 1 to 6 labels (capped at n squared), following any snake or ladder immediately.
Breadth-first search over squares gives the fewest throws; return -1 when the last square is never reached.
